name: Scaredy Rat
summary:
Previously, the rats had dug a hole in the ground in search of riches, but they found something much more peculiar.

But when one careless rat hit his head on some dirt, the entire hole COLLAPSED.

Now, you and your rat colony are stuck underground and are tasked with finding a way out of the underground. Finding your home again won't be easy, but you are responsible for the freedom of your entire colony.



Find your way, and pray you will make it out alive.
